sloka: स दण्डस्तत्र राजाभूद्रम्ये पर्वतरोधसि ।पुरं चाप्रतिमं राम न्यवेशयदनुत्तमम् ।। ७.७९.१७ ॥
transliteration: sa daṇḍastatra rājābhūdramye parvatarodhasi ।puraṁ cāpratimaṁ rāma nyaveśayadanuttamam ।। 7.79.17 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, he (Shatrughna), the wielder of justice, became king there on the beautiful mountain slope and established an unequalled, unsurpassed city.
